definitions.gloss: snow removal; snow clearing; snow plowing
definitions.explanation: The act of clearing accumulated snow from roads, sidewalks, rooftops, and other surfaces. A common winter activity in snowy regions of Japan, especially in Hokkaido and the Japan Sea side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{除雪|じょせつ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Snow removal work was carried out from the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{除雪|じょせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Some areas couldn't keep up with snow removal due to the heavy snowfall.

examples.english: In snow country, clearing snow in front of the house every morning is part of the daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({除雪|じょせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Very common in news reports during winter, especially regarding road conditions in northern Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除雪|じょせつ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (snow removal work)
- {除雪|じょせつ}{車|しゃ} (snowplow)
- {除雪|じょせつ}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (snow removal costs)
- ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{除雪|じょせつ} (clearing snow from rooftops)
